fixed_verifier.scope: JSON bytes, metadata, exact installed pin inspection; no model inference/training

common_controls.network: Docker --network none; no ports, host networking, DNS or provider access.
common_controls.host_exposure: Operator alone controls Docker; API never receives Docker socket. No host mounts, secrets or sockets; old image shares container-host kernel. Docker default seccomp applies, no distinct reviewed custom sandbox.
common_controls.privileges: UID/GID10001, read-only root, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges; no root fallback.
common_controls.input_surface: Only existing bounded JSON envelope stdin<=30MB, base64 decoded artifact<=20MB; JSON data only, no pickle/joblib/cloudpickle/model imports or deserialization.
common_controls.bounds: 512MiB RAM,1CPU,32PIDs,16MiB noexec/nosuid tmpfs; attached execution90s timeout, each Docker create/cleanup operation30s. Unique labelled create/start lifecycle and finally force-remove with daemon-side absence verification; uncertainty blocks success. Actual timeout cleanup proved separately with modern image, not historical execution authorization.
common_controls.startup_review_limit: python -I implies -s but not -S. Global site .pth executable lines and sitecustomize may run; complete startup import/native trace is not proven. Explicit embedded imports are not an exhaustive process import list. Python3.12 official CLI/site docs checked2026-10-29.
target_proof_required: Actual host/kernel/Docker versions and patch state
All invocation flags from real process
Envelope count/hash allowlist and total window
Human security and operator decisions with expiry
